title: On the number of spanning trees of bicirculant graphs
summary: A bi-Cayley graph over a cyclic group $\mathbb{Z}_n$ is called a bicirculant graph. Let $Γ=BC(\mathbb{Z}_n; R,T,S)$ be a bicirculant graph with $R=R^{-1}\subseteq \mathbb{Z}_n\setminus \{0\}$ and $T=T^{-1}\subseteq \mathbb{Z}_n\setminus \{0\}$ and $S\subseteq \mathbb{Z}_n$. In this paper, using Chebyshev polynomials, we obtain a closed formula for the number of spanning trees of bicirculant graph $Γ$, investigate some arithmetic properties of the number of spanning trees of $Γ$, and find its asymptotic behaviour as $n$ tends infinity.
